responsibility: This header is the primary target description header for the AArch64 port. It defines architectural constants, storage layout and ABI macros, ISA-feature flag enums and query macros, default option-spec machinery, target-wide type and alignment policies, SVE size macros, builtin hook entry points, and many backend-wide configuration macros that parameterize generic GCC code and connect the rest of the AArch64 implementation to the compiler’s target interface.
same_name_distinction: Among the same-stem aarch64 files, this is the primary C/C++ target description header of macros, enums, declarations, and policy definitions that parameterize the port. It differs from aarch64.cc, which implements behavior, from aarch64.md, which encodes RTL instruction patterns, and from aarch64.opt, which declares command-line options and target variables.
